killedBy: startGameWith: stats wiring sends the run total ONLY on the two endings that finish a run
why: Resolves a run total for every ending, so `mission-clear` shows a running campaign figure on every level and the practice and versus screens show a campaign the player was not playing. `mission-clear` is the sharp case: it IS campaign play and it IS mid-run, so a gate written as "is this a campaign session" instead of "did this end a run" looks correct and is not. The HUD hides the line by ABSENCE, so it has no second opinion to catch this with. Killed at the SESSION, not in the HUD: `hud.surfaces.test.ts` builds its own payload, so it proves the HUD renders a total when given one and hides the line when not -- it cannot see which endings the session resolves one for. That is this entry's claim, and it needed a loop case driving a real winning frame.
